scope: Two isolated Unity first-screen art-direction scenes only. Original characters, not copies of the supplied subjects.

prompts.prompt:
Create ORIGINAL game character concept art using the supplied images ONLY as visual language references, never their character identity, outfit, pose, symbols, exact equipment or layout. Bold angular dark-fantasy cartoon drawing: tapering limbs, expressive angular hands, slightly oversized boots and weapon silhouette, compact 5.5-head ADULT proportions, strong gesture and personality. A few imperfect bold near-black outlines, large graphic planes, muted earthy fills, ONE decisive hard shadow shape per material, a very sparse chunky edge highlight. Drawn like an economical animation model sheet rather than polished anime splash art. Simplified expressive face: short narrow eyes, geometric nose, two-stroke mouth; no glossy eyes or pretty idol face. No rendering gradients, soft shading, grain, dithering, tiny scratches, hatching, intricate strands, stippling or microtextures. No decorative line clutter. Simple clothing constructions with at most two essential accessories, enough asymmetric silhouette and character to avoid a featureless mannequin. Humble first-adventure gear, not a wealthy hero. Full-body single character from head to feet in 3/4 FRONT VIEW, centered with generous transparent margins. Strong broad black shadow masses. Muted olive-grey, dusty warm grey, bone, brown leather, muted rust-red plus small ochre accent, no neon, no gold filigree. Transparent background; no cast shadow, ground, scene, writing, watermark, signature or swatches. Large clean shapes retain definition at small size, while output remains a high-resolution illustration; no artificial coarse pixelation.
DESIGN: WARRIOR, face fully hidden inside a practical squat angular iron SALLET helmet with a short protruding brow and separate simple bevor jaw guard, narrow BLACK T-shaped visor gap, no face/hair. A short frayed olive charcoal shoulder mantle lies over modest uneven steel shoulder guards, smooth iron breastplate with a simple vertical seam, brown gloves, one square belt buckle, plain knee guards and chunky travel boots. One plain battered-looking short broadsword with broad trapezoid blade and straight guard in right hand, small rounded rectangular wooden buckler with 3 broad boards on left. Muted ochre neckcloth tucked under collar as sole warm accent. New adventurer, guarded slightly stooped ready stance, restrained armor construction. Enough cloth layering and useful armor articulation to feel designed, not a smooth grey robot. No crown, crest, spikes, heraldry, gold trim or cape sweeping the floor.

Create a game background illustration for a FIRST PERSON DUNGEON ENTRANCE, wide landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Original economical angular cartoon dark-fantasy visual language, thick irregular black outlines, broad clean flat muted dark olive-grey and warm charcoal planes. A humble deserted stone castle entry hall: central flat stone path in one-point perspective to a small dark pointed archway near upper middle, large stone support pillars on both sides, a couple of broken angular flagstones at foreground sides, one old wooden shut side door, ONLY two small ochre torch flames drawn as solid two-color shapes, no bloom. Deep shadow at ceiling and behind pillars. Central walking lane stays readable dark midtone olive-grey, side recesses nearly black, lighter restrained rim on arch stones. Five or six BIG stone planes, no dense brick grids or cracks networks; add only a few purposeful asymmetric silhouette breaks. Foreground bottom center remains uncluttered for a rear-view player bust, top 12% and bottom 15% darker quiet space for HUD. Empty hall with NO characters or monsters, no lettering, no UI. Low detail density, broad hard shadows, controlled flat color palette ~10 muted earthy tones. NO gradient, soft lighting, fog, atmospheric fading, grain, hatching, dots, texture or realistic 3D rendering. Match the supplied character references' bold angular contour and solid shadow language; create an ORIGINAL environment. High-resolution crisp raster, no coarse-pixel reduction.
